query:
SELECT 
  DATE(dataConclusao) AS dia,
  DAYNAME(dataConclusao) AS dia_semana,
  COUNT(*) AS total_os,
  SUM(COALESCE(qtdApInstalado, 0)) AS total_aps,
  COUNT(DISTINCT tecnicoId) AS tecnicos_ativos
FROM ordens_servico
WHERE status = 'concluida'
  AND dataConclusao IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY DATE(dataConclusao)
ORDER BY total_os DESC
LIMIT 15;
